title: Upload staging with quarantine, validation and promotion
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that invalid files are left in quarantine rather than deleted. That is deliberate: promotion is the only path into final/, validation failure leaves evidence for inspection in quarantine, and the contract — invalid files are never promoted — is asserted for both oversize and wrong-type uploads.
